task_name: World 101 Task A  -  Three-Entity Intercompany & Wholesale Deposit Misattribution
prompt: Audit the Q3 2026 three-entity general ledger (`qbo_three_entity_gl_2026_Q3.xlsx`) and the temp bookkeeper's memo (`bookkeeper_memo_sept_2026.txt`) for Roast & Co. Coffee Corp, Roast & Co. Downtown LLC, and Roast & Co. Northside LLC. Identify any misattributed wholesale customer collections, evaluate whether the September 2026 wire discussed in the bookkeeper's memo is a vendor rebate or an intercompany transfer, and specify the required correcting journal entries.

rubric.description: Identifies the $84,250.00 Metro Foodservice Group ACH deposit (DEP-901) booked to 4100 Wholesale Revenue in Roast & Co. Coffee Corp.
Identifies that Invoice DT-4412 ($84,250.00) belongs to Roast & Co. Downtown LLC's AR subledger, so crediting 4100 Wholesale Revenue in Corp double-counts revenue and leaves Downtown AR overstated.
Reports total open AR in Roast & Co. Downtown LLC before correction as $115,450.00 and after applying the $84,250.00 Metro Foodservice collection as $31,200.00.

Rejects the bookkeeper memo claim that WIRE-904 ($19,400.00) is a green coffee vendor rebate, citing the Chase wire addendum and Northside GL (WIRE-NS-18) showing an intercompany cash sweep from Northside Checking #2002.
Quantifies total Corp revenue overstatement in September 2026 from DEP-901 ($84,250.00) and WIRE-904 ($19,400.00) as $103,650.00.
Proposes reclassifying Corp WIRE-904 by debiting 4900 Other Income $19,400.00 and crediting 2450 Due to Roast Northside (Intercompany Payable) $19,400.00.

Proposes reversing Corp's $84,250.00 revenue credit on DEP-901 (Dr 4100 Wholesale Revenue $84,250.00 / Cr 2460 Due to Roast Downtown $84,250.00) and clearing Downtown AR (Dr 1460 Due from Roast Corp $84,250.00 / Cr 1100 Accounts Receivable $84,250.00).
Reports GreenSprout Wholesale (DT-4419) as the sole remaining open Downtown AR balance at $31,200.00.

gold_output:
World 101 Task A  -  Three-Entity Intercompany & Wholesale Deposit Audit:
1. Misattributed Wholesale Deposit (DEP-901): Metro Foodservice Group ACH deposit of $84,250.00 was booked to 4100 Wholesale Revenue in Roast & Co. Coffee Corp, but Invoice DT-4412 ($84,250.00) belongs to Roast & Co. Downtown LLC's AR subledger. Crediting 4100 Wholesale Revenue in Corp double-counts revenue and leaves Downtown AR overstated.
2. Downtown AR Subledger Tie-Out: Total open AR in Roast & Co. Downtown LLC before correction is $115,450.00. After applying the $84,250.00 Metro Foodservice collection, remaining open Downtown AR is $31,200.00, consisting solely of GreenSprout Wholesale (DT-4419) at $31,200.00.
3. Rejected Bookkeeper Rebate Memo (WIRE-904): We reject the bookkeeper memo claim that WIRE-904 ($19,400.00) is a green coffee vendor rebate. The Chase wire addendum and Northside GL (WIRE-NS-18, debiting 1450 Due from Roast Corp $19,400.00 and crediting Northside Checking #2002) prove it is an intercompany cash sweep from Roast & Co. Northside LLC.
4. Total Corp Revenue Overstatement: $84,250.00 + $19,400.00 = $103,650.00.
5. Correcting Journal Entries:
   - WIRE-904 (Corp): Dr 4900 Other Income $19,400.00 / Cr 2450 Due to Roast Northside (Intercompany Payable) $19,400.00.
   - DEP-901 (Corp): Dr 4100 Wholesale Revenue $84,250.00 / Cr 2460 Due to Roast Downtown $84,250.00.
   - DEP-901 (Downtown): Dr 1460 Due from Roast Corp $84,250.00 / Cr 1100 Accounts Receivable $84,250.00.
